_: Policy for .github/scripts/dep-audit-gate.mjs. Every exception needs a reason, a whyNotFixed, a reviewTrigger and an expiry date. An expired entry fails the build — that is the point. Do not extend an entry without redoing the analysis; remove it once the underlying fix lands.

exceptions.reason: Path traversal in serve-static via encoded backslash, Windows only. Pulled in solely by @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's HTTP/SSE transports, which this project never loads: scripts/mcp-bpmn-server.js imports StdioServerTransport only, and scripts/http-server.js uses node:http directly rather than express. serveStatic is never called and there is no Windows deployment path. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is listed alongside @hono/node-server because npm reports it as a separate finding via the effects chain (`via: ["@hono/node-server"]`) — it is the same single advisory, not a second risk.
exceptions.whyNotFixed: The fix requires @hono/node-server >=2.0.5, but @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0 declares "@hono/node-server": "^1.19.9" as a non-optional runtime dependency. npm's only proposed remedy is a semver-major *downgrade* of the SDK to 1.24.3 (`fixAvailable: {"name":"@modelcontextprotocol/sdk","version":"1.24.3","isSemVerMajor":true}`) — there is no forward fix. An override to 2.x would run the SDK outside its declared and tested range in order to patch a code path we never execute.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk widens its @hono/node-server range to admit >=2.0.5 (`npm view @modelcontextprotocol/sdk dependencies`), or this project adopts an HTTP/SSE MCP transport — the latter is caught automatically by voidIf below.
